scope: Post-protocol robustness audit declared before inspecting new AURORA held-out quality outcomes; not part of the original confirmatory contrasts
motivation: Duplicating correlated features changes the effective L2 penalty, so a ridge prediction gain alone need not identify uniquely new information.
controls: Duplicate all three baseline features once (six columns, ridge alpha=10)
Duplicate only baseline error rate three additional times (six columns, ridge alpha=10)
Unpenalized standardized OLS, baseline three versus augmented six features; fixed lstsq rcond=1e-10
unchanged: All original frozen predictors, tests, repairs and primary intervals
All generated states and evaluator losses
Calibration-only fitting and no selection among sensitivity outcomes
inference: All controls and all conditions reported; descriptive 95% paired sequence bootstrap intervals with the same shared-seed dependence. No test-based hyperparameter selection.
extension: Apply to earlier ELF evidence where its saved calibration and test features support the identical audit.
